name: whisper-medium-isixhosa
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-medium (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-04. A finetune of openai/whisper-medium, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.764 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence cc-by-4.0, repo created 2026-10-19. CAVEAT: the base numbers are rows in the card's Scores table ('Stock whisper-medium on FLEURS, for comparison') rather than a full base column, so the head-to-head holds on FLEURS xh_za only. The model borrows Whisper's Swahili token for isiXhosa; language='sw' must be passed at inference.

benchmarks.name: FLEURS xh_za test WER %
benchmarks.config: Card 'Scores' table, row 'FLEURS xh_za test (1034 clips)': this model WER 30.32 vs the italic base row 'Stock whisper-medium on FLEURS' 142.32, same column, same table. Lower is better. Base row is a row in the table rather than its own column. Light normalisation: lowercase, punctuation removed.
